children: Toro Co reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to $1.23B and diluted EPS of $0.81, driven by volume gains across its Professional and Residential businesses and the recent Tornado acquisition.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share of common stock”.
Revenue growth: Consolidated net sales increased 8.4% for the quarter and 7.0% year-to-date, supported by Professional and Residential volume and the Tornado acquisition.

Channel & inventory: Field inventory replenishment continued, with higher levels in underground construction products; finished goods inventories were down year-over-year following a strong mowing season.
Brand & product momentum: Professional gains were led by underground construction, snow/ice equipment and stand-on mowers; Residential strength came from walk power mowers and snow products.
Operational initiatives: The AMP productivity program is nearing a $125M run-rate savings target by FY2027, with approximately $124M in cumulative savings delivered to date and ongoing reinvestment.
Operational milestones: Toro closed its Monterrey facility, exited a residential mower platform, and completed the Tornado acquisition to expand its hydrovac offerings.
